run_test_template_dir_resolution: run the unittest test suite for template_dir path resolution in the openevolve config module
test_relative_template_dir: test that relative template_dir paths resolve relative to the config file location
test_absolute_template_dir: test that absolute template_dir paths remain unchanged when loading a config from YAML
test_null_template_dir: test that a null template_dir value remains None after loading config from YAML
test_nested_relative_template_dir: test that nested relative paths like ../templates/custom resolve correctly relative to the config file
